dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That's definitely something worth looking out for.

dialogues.speaker: Nami
dialogues.text: See? I knew I was right.

dialogues.speaker: Nami
dialogues.text: I've been more strict with people coming in and out from the harbor recently as well. We don't just need to stop Shogunate operatives from getting in, but we need to guard against smuggling and stowaways as well.

dialogues.speaker: Nami
dialogues.text: Harbors are transport hubs, after all. Can't ever be too careful.
